title: ShebaMiles incident: unconfirmed account estimate removed
what_changed: The summary and plain said Addis Fortune reported fewer than 8,000 accounts reached. Airways Magazine (19 Nov) says an account-count estimate in the Addis Fortune report carries an editor's note that Ethiopian had not officially confirmed it, and Reuters says the scale was not immediately clear; the figure was removed. Added the commercial chief's statements (contained; data and miles not taken or altered) as relayed by Airways Magazine, and the Reuters and Airways pages as sources. The action now gives the airline's own advice.
